total_supply_initial.meaning: totalSupply value pre-set by the HypoVault constructor
total_supply_initial.checkpoint: constructor execution, before any deposit or fulfilment

vault_asset_balance_initial.meaning: underlying asset balance owned by the vault at construction time
vault_asset_balance_initial.checkpoint: constructor execution, before any deposit or fulfilment

total_assets_before_first_fulfilment.meaning: totalAssets (computeNAV()) value before the first fulfilment

first_deposit_shares_received.meaning: sharesReceived minted for the very first deposit

first_deposit_assets_to_fulfill.meaning: assetsToFulfill for the very first deposit

withdrawal_shares_burned.meaning: number of shares burned by a withdrawal

withdrawal_assets_released.meaning: underlying assets released by a withdrawal

assumptions: The first deposit is the very first fulfilment of the vault.
totalAssets is measured before the first fulfilment action.

unresolved.description: Report does not state the checkpoint at which totalAssets is measured relative to the deposit action, so the condition binding total_assets_before_first_fulfilment to the first-deposit scenario is a report-supported but not fully pinned ordering.

Report does not give the exact share-minting formula operands beyond the 1-wei denominator, so the numeric relation between sharesReceived and assetsToFulfill is only stated as an equality intent, not derived.

limitations: The selected impact is potential; the plan encodes only the report-supported conditional scenario and does not assert the withdrawal burn outcome as certain.

The impact's 'huge numbers of shares for tiny (or zero) assets' magnitude is represented qualitatively via withdrawal_assets_released <= 1 and withdrawal_shares_burned > 0; no exact magnitude is stated in the report.
The intent equality is formalized as a value_relation obligation; the report does not supply the underlying mint formula, so the relation is not derived from operands.
